fah-319.title: Shateeta (Hot Pepper Relish)
fah-319.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-319.culturalNotes: Shateeta goes with breakfast, beans, ta'ameya, potatoes, pasta, koshari, okra and molokhia. It keeps in the fridge for a week.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the hot peppers and stir for a minute until they start to colour.
instructions.3: Add the minced garlic and the spices (salt, cumin, coriander, black pepper) and stir for another minute.
instructions.4: Add the tomato cubes and stir for a minute.
instructions.5: Add the vinegar and leave it to boil for two minutes.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture to a container and leave it to cool.
instructions.7: Keep the shateeta in an airtight container in the fridge.

fah-320.title: Melty Cheese Sauce
fah-320.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-320.culturalNotes: Serve the sauce with fried potatoes, pizza or pané. It keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Put the milk in a pot over low heat.
instructions.2: Add the cornflour and stir well.
instructions.3: Keep stirring over low heat until the mixture thickens.
instructions.4: Add the cheese and stir until completely melted.
instructions.5: When the mixture boils, add the butter and stir until melted.
instructions.6: Take the pot off the heat and keep stirring until the sauce reaches the right consistency.

fah-321.title: Pasta Sauce with Steak & Onions
fah-321.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-321.culturalNotes: Serve with a green salad or fresh bread. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and butter in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the steak and stir until golden on all sides.
instructions.3: Add the salt and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the crushed garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.5: Add the onions and stir until golden.
instructions.6: Add the sugar and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the demi-glace powder and stir well.
instructions.8: Add boiling water and leave until it boils.
instructions.9: Add the pasta and stir well.
instructions.10: Add some of the pasta cooking water and stir well.
instructions.11: Add the crushed chilli flakes and stir well.
instructions.12: Add cream to taste if you like.

fah-322.title: Melty Cheese Skillets
fah-322.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-322.culturalNotes: Serve the skillets hot with a side green salad. Different cheeses work, as you like.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the flour and stir for a minute.
instructions.3: Add the milk and stir until the flour dissolves.
instructions.4: Add the cream cheese, cheddar and mozzarella and stir until the cheese melts.
instructions.5: Add a pinch of saffron colouring, the salt and pepper, and stir well.
instructions.6: In another pot, sauté the sausages, mixed peppers, sun-dried tomatoes, olives and pasta, then add the cheese sauce and stir.
instructions.7: Prepare the skillets: add the pasta and sauce mixture, then top with cheese.
instructions.8: Repeat for the potato and hot pepper skillet with sauce and cheese.
instructions.9: Repeat for the sujuk and mixed pepper skillet with sauce and cheese.
instructions.10: Put the skillets in a preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes until the cheese melts and browns on top.

fah-323.title: Alexandrian Fatta
fah-323.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-323.culturalNotes: You can add a stock cube to the sauce for a stronger taste. The fatta keeps in the fridge for two days — reheat before serving.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat and add the mastic until it melts.
instructions.2: Add the meat and stir until it changes colour.
instructions.3: Add the carrots, onions, tomatoes, bay leaf and cardamom powder, and stir well.
instructions.4: Add water to cover the meat and leave over low heat until cooked.
instructions.5: Wash and drain the rice, then sauté it in a pot with the ghee, oil and mastic until glossy.
instructions.6: Add the salt and instant stock, and pour in water to cover the rice by about 1 cm.
instructions.7: Cover the rice and leave over low heat until cooked.
instructions.8: Make the sauce by blending the hot chilli and tomatoes, then straining it.
instructions.9: Crush the garlic with the salt, then fry it in a pot with the ghee until golden.
instructions.10: Add the vinegar and chopped tomatoes and leave until thickened.
instructions.11: Cut the baladi bread into small cubes and toast in the oven until golden.
instructions.12: Make the tasha dressing by mixing the remaining garlic with ghee, then adding the vinegar and broth.
instructions.13: Spread the bread in the serving tray and moisten it with broth.
instructions.14: Add the rice tossed in ghee, then moisten with more broth.
instructions.15: Add the meat, then top with the sauce and the tasha dressing.

fah-324.title: Hawawshi Fatta
fah-324.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-324.culturalNotes: Any long-grain rice can replace the basmati. Sprinkling grated cheese over the hawawshi before it goes in the oven gives a golden crisp top.

instructions.1: Mix the minced meat with the hawawshi spices, tahini, minced onion, minced green pepper, black pepper and salt.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture well until smooth.
instructions.3: Take a piece of the bread, place some of the mixture on it and spread it out.
instructions.4: Roll the bread into a roll and cut it into slices about a centimetre wide.
instructions.5: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the hawawshi slices until golden.
instructions.6: Put the hawawshi in a tray and into a preheated oven at 200°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Wash and drain the basmati rice, put it in a pot with the ghee and oil and stir.
instructions.8: Add the spices (cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, whole black peppercorns) and stir into the rice.
instructions.9: Add the broth and salt and leave the rice to absorb for 15 minutes over low heat.
instructions.10: Add the ground saffron and stir well, then cover the pot and leave the rice to cook.
instructions.11: Mix the tahini, yogurt, duqqa, lemon juice, vinegar, mayonnaise and water to a medium consistency.
instructions.12: Put the rice in the serving dish and scatter the hawawshi over it.
instructions.13: Pour the tahini sauce over the hawawshi and garnish with parsley or fresh coriander, peanuts and pomegranate molasses.

fah-325.title: Liver Fatta
fah-325.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-325.culturalNotes: Add chilli to taste. The fatta keeps in the fridge for one day.

instructions.1: Cut the liver into small cubes.
instructions.2: Season the liver with the cinnamon, coriander, cumin, salt, pepper, garlic and vinegar. Stir well.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pan and add the liver. Stir until cooked through, without over-stirring.
instructions.4: Add the mixed-colour peppers and hot chilli and stir for a minute.
instructions.5: In another pan, heat a little oil and add the garlic. Sauté until golden.
instructions.6: Add the coriander and vinegar and stir. Add half a cup of tomato sauce and leave it to boil.
instructions.7: Add half a cup of water and adjust the salt and pepper. Leave the sauce until thickened.
instructions.8: Cook the white rice in boiling water with the ghee, oil and mastic until done.
instructions.9: Toast the bread in the oven until golden and crisp.
instructions.10: In the serving dish, place the white rice and toasted bread. Pour the sauce over them.
instructions.11: Scatter the liver and coloured peppers over the rice and bread.
instructions.12: Make the tahini sauce by mixing the tahini, mayonnaise, minced garlic, salt, pepper, cumin, coriander and vinegar with half a cup of water. Pour the sauce over the fatta.

fah-326.title: Caramel Popcorn
fah-326.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-326.culturalNotes: Keep the heat low when popping so it doesn't burn. Don't increase the baking soda or the caramel will turn bitter.

instructions.1: Put a pot over the heat and add two tablespoons of oil, then lower the heat.
instructions.2: Add the kernels and cover the pot, leaving a small gap for steam.
instructions.3: Leave the kernels over low heat until they start popping.
instructions.4: Prepare a tray and grease it well with oil.
instructions.5: In another pan, put a cup of sugar and a quarter cup of water over the heat until it caramelises.
instructions.6: Don't stir the caramel at first — just gently shake the pan.
instructions.7: Once the caramel is golden, add a quarter teaspoon of baking soda and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the caramel to the popcorn and stir until all the kernels are coated.
instructions.9: Pour the caramel popcorn into the greased tray and leave it to cool and dry.
instructions.10: Once cool, break it up gently and serve.

fah-327.title: Syrian Chickpea Falafel
fah-327.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-327.culturalNotes: The dough keeps in the freezer for a long time if left unseasoned. Make sure the oil is hot but not smoking when frying so the falafel don't absorb grease.

instructions.1: Soak the chickpeas for at least 12 hours, then wash and drain them.
instructions.2: Put the chickpeas in the food processor with the parsley, coriander, onion and garlic, and grind until smooth.
instructions.3: If the dough needs water, add a quarter cup.
instructions.4: Add the salt, cumin, ground coriander and baking soda and knead well.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small balls and coat them in sesame seeds.
instructions.6: Fry the falafel in hot oil until golden and crisp.
instructions.7: Make the tahini sauce by mixing the tahini, yogurt, duqqa and water.
instructions.8: Serve the falafel with bread, tomatoes, pickled cucumbers, tahini, pomegranate and parsley.

fah-328.title: Kofta Kabsa
fah-328.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-328.culturalNotes: Serve the kabsa with daqqous salad or any salad you like. It keeps in the fridge for two days, or freeze it for longer.

instructions.1: Mix the minced meat with the chopped parsley, minced garlic, breadcrumbs, seven-spice, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients well until combined.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta into small, even balls.
instructions.4: Heat the oil and ghee in a pot over the heat.
instructions.5: Add the kofta and sauté until golden on all sides.
instructions.6: Lift the kofta out of the pot and set aside.
instructions.7: In the same pot, add the chopped onion and garlic and sauté until golden.
instructions.8: Add the dried lime, cinnamon, cardamom, salt and pepper, and stir well.
instructions.9: Add the concentrated tomato juice and leave until thickened.
instructions.10: Add the boiling water and leave until it boils.
instructions.11: Return the kofta to the pot with the sauce.
instructions.12: Add the stock cube and leave the mixture to boil.
instructions.13: Add the rice and leave until covered by the water or sauce.
instructions.14: Add the peppers and cover the pot, then leave over low heat until the rice is cooked.
instructions.15: Give the kabsa one gentle stir, then cover again and leave until fully cooked.

fah-329.title: Kuymak (Cornmeal & Cheese) with Tomato
fah-329.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-329.culturalNotes: You can add baladi or Turkish sujuk to the sauce for extra flavour. Serve the kuymak with tomatoes, cucumber and black olives.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the yellow cornmeal and stir until well toasted.
instructions.3: Add the water and stir until the mixture comes together.
instructions.4: Add the mozzarella and stir until it melts and the mixture is smooth.
instructions.5: In another pot, heat the ghee, add the chopped onion and sauté until golden.
instructions.6: Add the hot chilli and stir briefly.
instructions.7: Add the grated tomatoes, salt and black pepper and leave the mixture to thicken slightly.
instructions.8: Add the eggs and stir gently until cooked.
instructions.9: Serve the kuymak hot with Turkish simit and tea.

fah-138.title: Crispy Fish Strips
fah-138.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-138.culturalNotes: Any kind of fish works here. The strips keep in the fridge for two days. Serve with white rice or salad.

fah-138-i2.name: Fish spices (thyme, cumin, coriander, paprika, dried parsley)

instructions.1: Cut the fish into medium strips.
instructions.2: Mix the fish spices, garlic powder, onion powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.3: Coat the fish strips in the mix and leave for half an hour.
instructions.4: Mix the flour, cornflour, salt, onion powder and fish spices in another bowl.
instructions.5: Dip the fish strips in water, then in the flour mixture, repeating until you have a thick coating.
instructions.6: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.7: Fry the fish strips until golden and crisp.
instructions.8: Serve the strips with pickled aubergine.

fah-139.title: Fried Shrimp with Bissara
fah-139.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-139.culturalNotes: Add other spices to taste — black pepper or a mixed blend. The shrimp also goes well with salad or rice.

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp well under running water 3 times.
instructions.2: Cut off the heads and remove the vein from the underside.
instructions.3: Wash the shrimp once more and drain well.
instructions.4: Toss the shrimp with the cumin, coriander, salt, crushed garlic, lemon juice and chilli.
instructions.5: Toss the shrimp in the flour.
instructions.6: Drop the shrimp into hot oil and fry until golden.
instructions.7: Skewer the shrimp 4 pieces at a time, in the traditional way.
instructions.8: Serve the shrimp hot with fried bissara.

fah-140.title: Marinade for Grilled Fish
fah-140.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-140.culturalNotes: The marinade keeps in a jar in the fridge for months.

instructions.1: Make the marinade: blend the garlic, hot chilli and green and red peppers.
instructions.2: Add the vinegar, lemon juice, cumin, dried coriander and salt and mix well.
instructions.3: Make the stuffing: mix the grated carrot, parsley, dill, tomatoes and onion with 4 tablespoons of the marinade and salt.
instructions.4: Stuff the fish with the stuffing.
instructions.5: Grill the fish until golden.
instructions.6: Make the basting sauce: mix the rest of the stuffing with water and salt.
instructions.7: Pour the sauce over the grilled fish.

fah-141.title: Homemade Preserved Mackerel (Tuna-Style)
fah-141.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-141.culturalNotes: Serve the homemade tuna with onion salad and lemon juice, adding salt to taste.

instructions.1: Prepare the cooking ingredients: 2 kg mackerel, a bunch of celery, two carrots, 3 lemons, two onions, 10 tomatoes, 2 bay leaves, 2 tablespoons of salt, a teaspoon of cumin and 2 tablespoons of vinegar.
instructions.2: Add two litres of water to a pot and bring to the boil.
instructions.3: Add all the vegetables and spices to the boiling water.
instructions.4: Add the fish pieces to the water and boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Lower the heat and leave the fish to cook gently for 90 minutes.
instructions.6: Lift the fish out of the water and remove the skin and bones.
instructions.7: Strain the water of the vegetables and spices and keep it for preserving.
instructions.8: Pack the fish pieces into a clean, dry jar.
instructions.9: Add 2 bay leaves and hot chilli to taste.
instructions.10: Add half a cup of vinegar and half a cup of oil to the jar.
instructions.11: Stir the contents gently and keep the jar in the fridge for 3–4 days before eating.
instructions.12: The jar keeps in the fridge for over a month.

fah-142.title: Homemade Canned Tuna
fah-142.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-142.culturalNotes: Mackerel works instead of tuna with similar results. Add garlic slices during boiling for a stronger flavour.

instructions.1: Buy the tuna and ask the fishmonger to clean it and cut it into steaks.
instructions.2: Put the steaks in a large dish, cover with water and vinegar and leave for an hour.
instructions.3: In a pot, put the water, lemon slices, onion, carrot, celery, black peppercorns, salt and vinegar, and bring to the boil.
instructions.4: Add the tuna steaks to the pot and leave over low heat for an hour.
instructions.5: After an hour, lift the tuna out and put it on a rack to cool.
instructions.6: Once cooled, separate the flesh from the bones and skin.
instructions.7: Keep the poaching liquid and add the sliced garlic to it.
instructions.8: Put the tuna in sterilised jars and add the chilli pods and black peppercorns.
instructions.9: Fill the jars halfway with the liquid, then add half a cup of brine and half a cup of oil.
instructions.10: Seal the jars and keep in the fridge for 3–4 days before eating.

fah-143.title: Battered Shrimp & Potatoes
fah-143.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-143.culturalNotes: Use frying potatoes, hot oil and medium heat for the best result. Serve with ketchup or any sauce you like.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into medium-thick pieces and soak in boiling water with a pinch of salt for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Drain the potatoes and leave to cool.
instructions.3: Mix the flour with the paprika, turmeric, onion powder, garlic powder, baking powder, salt, black pepper and chilli.
instructions.4: Add water gradually to the flour mixture until it reaches a pancake-batter consistency.
instructions.5: Dip the cooled potatoes in the batter.
instructions.6: Heat the oil over medium heat and fry the potatoes piece by piece until golden.
instructions.7: Toss the shrimp in the same batter and fry in the hot oil until golden.

fah-144.title: Shrimp Spring Rolls
fah-144.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-144.culturalNotes: The spring rolls can be frozen and used when needed. Serve hot with soy sauce and ketchup for a great taste.

instructions.1: Wash and clean the shrimp well, then remove the vein from the underside.
instructions.2: Add the fish marinade and soy sauce to the shrimp and mix well.
instructions.3: Leave the shrimp in the marinade for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut the underside so the shrimp doesn't curl during frying.
instructions.5: Take a spring roll wrapper and place some shrimp in the centre.
instructions.6: Wrap the sheet around the shrimp as shown in the video, using water to seal the edge.
instructions.7: Repeat until all the shrimp are used.
instructions.8: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.9: Serve the fried spring rolls with soy sauce and ketchup to taste.

fah-145.title: Crispy Fish & Shrimp Strips with Rice
fah-145.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-145.culturalNotes: Other kinds of fish work too. Make sure the oil is properly hot before frying for the perfect crunch.

instructions.1: Wash the fish and shrimp well and cut the fish into medium strips.
instructions.2: Make the marinade from the crispy coating mix, water, garlic and lemon juice. Stir well.
instructions.3: Soak the fish and shrimp in the marinade for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the fish and shrimp until golden and crisp.
instructions.5: In another pan, sauté the onion until lightly golden, add the minced garlic and stir together.
instructions.6: Add the washed rice to the onion and garlic and stir well. Add the boiling water and salt and stir again.
instructions.7: Cover the pan and leave the rice to cook over low heat until done.
instructions.8: Five minutes before the rice is done, add the sorrel and chopped coriander and stir well.
instructions.9: Serve the crispy fish and shrimp with the herb rice, tomato sauce, pickles, fahana relish and chilli.

fah-146.title: Sardines Preserved in Lemon & Oil
fah-146.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-146.culturalNotes: The preserved sardines are ready two days after storing and keep in the fridge for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Open the tin of sardines and empty it.
instructions.2: Remove the heads and innards and clean the sardines.
instructions.3: Place the sardines in a dish.
instructions.4: Squeeze the lemons over the sardines.
instructions.5: Cover the sardines in oil.
instructions.6: Seal the container tightly and store in the fridge.

fah-147.title: Salt-Cured Sardines
fah-147.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-147.culturalNotes: Dry the sardines well before seasoning for a good cure. Turn the jar daily so the salt and oil distribute evenly.

instructions.1: Choose fresh sardines and wash them well.
instructions.2: Arrange the sardines in a colander and leave for two hours to dry.
instructions.3: Dry the sardines thoroughly with a towel to make sure no water remains.
instructions.4: Make the curing mix from the salt, chilli, paprika and turmeric and stir well.
instructions.5: Slice the celery and lemon thinly.
instructions.6: Stuff the sardines' gills with the curing mix.
instructions.7: Sprinkle salt on all sides of the sardines.
instructions.8: Lay a layer of celery and lemon at the bottom of the jar.
instructions.9: Pack the sardines in the jar, adding more celery and lemon between layers.
instructions.10: Pour the vegetable oil over the sardines.
instructions.11: Seal the jar tightly and turn it daily until ready after 5 days.
instructions.12: Keep the jar at room temperature or in the fridge.

fah-148.title: Baked Mullet with Potatoes & Vegetables
fah-148.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-148.culturalNotes: Mackerel works instead of mullet with a lovely taste. The marinade keeps in the freezer for other recipes.

instructions.1: Prepare the fish: clean it, trim the fins and make slits in it.
instructions.2: Prepare the vegetables: slice the potatoes, onions, tomatoes, peppers, celery and coriander.
instructions.3: Make the stuffing: mix the marinade with the celery and coriander and stuff the fish inside and out.
instructions.4: Prepare the tray: spread the potatoes, onions, tomatoes and peppers in the baking tray.
instructions.5: Lay the fish over the vegetables and garnish with lemon, tomato and pepper slices.
instructions.6: Season the fish inside and out with the vinegar and oil.
instructions.7: Cover the tray with foil and bake in a preheated 240°C oven for half an hour.
instructions.8: Remove the foil and put the tray under the grill until browned.
instructions.9: Serve the fish hot with white rice or sayadeya rice, as you like.

fah-149.title: Oven-Smoked Fish
fah-149.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-149.culturalNotes: Use fresh, well-washed fish for the best flavour. Any kind of fish works.

instructions.1: Make the marinade: mix the minced garlic, pomegranate molasses, chilli, cumin, mustard, salt, oil, lemon juice and smoked paprika in a bowl.
instructions.2: Spread the marinade over the fish slices evenly.
instructions.3: Arrange the fish slices in a tray and put it in a very hot oven at the highest temperature.
instructions.4: Cover the tray with foil and bake for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Take the fish out of the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.

fah-150.title: Oven-Grilled Fish, Shrimp in Tomato & Marinated Aubergine
fah-150.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-150.culturalNotes: The duqqa keeps in a dry place away from moisture for a month. Serve the meal with a green salad or yogurt.

instructions.1: Make the duqqa: blend the hot and sweet peppers, fresh coriander, chilli, garlic head, vinegar, lemon juice, salt, cumin and dried coriander until smooth.
instructions.2: Prepare the fish: wash it well, then rub it with the duqqa inside and out. Wrap it in foil and bake in a hot oven until golden.
instructions.3: Prepare the shrimp: wash and clean them, then toss with the minced onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, grated carrot, duqqa, celery, lemon juice and oil. Put the mixture in a tray and bake until cooked.
instructions.4: Prepare the marinated aubergine: peel the aubergine, slice it and brown it in a tray with a little oil until golden. Put it in a serving dish and add the duqqa, parsley and tahini.
instructions.5: Prepare the rice: brown the onion in oil, then add the sugar until the onion turns honey-coloured. Add the boiling water, rice, salt, cumin and vegetable stock. Cover the pot and leave the rice until cooked.

fah-151.title: Seafood & Fish Tray Bake with Potatoes
fah-151.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-151.culturalNotes: Any kind of fish works. Leftovers keep in the fridge for two days. Serve the tray with a green salad.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into thin strips.
instructions.2: Put the potatoes in a deep dish and add the lemon juice, mustard, cumin, salt and garlic. Mix well.
instructions.3: Clean the fish well and open the belly. Spread half the marinade over the fish.
instructions.4: Spread the rest of the marinade over the potatoes and lay them in the tray under the fish.
instructions.5: Add the seafood (mussels, calamari, shrimp) to the tray and spread the remaining marinade over it.
instructions.6: In another pot, melt the butter and add the minced onion. Sauté until golden.
instructions.7: Add the flour and mix until it disappears. Add the milk, salt, black pepper and boiling water, and stir to a light sauce.
instructions.8: Pour the sauce over the fish, seafood and potatoes. Add two tablespoons of cream.
instructions.9: Put the tray in a very hot oven on the middle rack for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: In another pot, heat the oil and add the minced onion. Sauté until golden.
instructions.11: Add the strained tomatoes and tomato paste and stir well.
instructions.12: Add the rice and shrimp-shell broth (made by boiling shrimp shells with water and spices). Stir well and adjust the salt.
instructions.13: Cover the rice and leave over high heat until it absorbs, then stir and lower the heat.
instructions.14: Serve the tray hot with the red rice.

fah-152.title: Amazing Shrimp Tagine
fah-152.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-152.culturalNotes: Make sure the oven is preheated for 15 minutes before the tagine goes in. Serve with white rice or bread.

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp well, open the back and remove the sand vein.
instructions.2: Slice the onions and add them to the tagine.
instructions.3: Add the salt, dried coriander, garlic and cumin and stir.
instructions.4: Add the celery, tomatoes and hot and sweet peppers, squeeze the lemons over everything and leave the peel in the tagine.
instructions.5: Add the shrimp and stir well.
instructions.6: Cover the tagine and put it in a preheated 200°C oven for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Take the tagine out of the oven and serve hot.

fah-153.title: Oven Shrimp Tagine
fah-153.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-153.culturalNotes: The duqqa keeps in the fridge for a month. Serve the tagine with sayadeya rice or marinated aubergine.

instructions.1: Wash and clean the shrimp well.
instructions.2: Slice the onions thinly.
instructions.3: Slice the tomatoes and bell pepper.
instructions.4: Grate the carrot.
instructions.5: Prepare the duqqa as shown at the start of the video.
instructions.6: Cut the celery into small pieces.
instructions.7: Add the onion, tomatoes, bell pepper and carrot to the duqqa.
instructions.8: Add the shrimp to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.9: Add the oil and boiling water to the mixture.
instructions.10: Put the mixture in a baking tray and cover it.
instructions.11: Bake in a hot oven for 30 minutes until the shrimp is cooked and nicely coloured.

fah-154.title: Surprise Seafood Tagine
fah-154.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-154.culturalNotes: Other kinds of fish or shellfish can be added. Serve the tagine with white rice or bread.

instructions.1: Cut the fish, calamari and crab into small cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the celery and mixed peppers into small cubes.
instructions.3: Chop the onion and garlic finely.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a pot, add the onion and sauté until golden.
instructions.5: Add the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the mixed peppers and stir for a minute.
instructions.7: Add the black pepper and salt and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the flour and stir until it disappears.
instructions.9: Add the shrimp, fish and calamari and stir until sealed.
instructions.10: Add the shrimp broth and stir until it boils.
instructions.11: Add the hot milk and stir until it boils and thickens.
instructions.12: Add the chilli, cream and cream cheese and stir well.
instructions.13: Pour the mixture into a baking tray and top with mozzarella.
instructions.14: Bake in a very hot oven until browned.

fah-155.title: Molokhia & Shrimp Tagine
fah-155.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-155.culturalNotes: Clean the shrimp well and remove the sand vein. Don't cover the pot while cooking or the molokhia will darken. You can garnish with two shrimp.

instructions.1: Heat a teaspoon of ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add a third of the minced garlic, half the hot chilli and half the dried coriander. Stir until the garlic is lightly golden.
instructions.3: Add the shrimp and stir with the garlic, chilli and coriander until it changes colour.
instructions.4: Add the stock cube, salt and shrimp broth. Leave the mixture to boil.
instructions.5: Add another third of the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the molokhia and stir with a whisk until completely loosened.
instructions.7: Add more shrimp broth or water as needed for the right consistency.
instructions.8: Turn off the heat once the molokhia boils — don't leave it long or it will drop.
instructions.9: Transfer to a tagine and serve.
instructions.10: Make the tasha in a small pot with a teaspoon of ghee.
instructions.11: Add the remaining garlic, chilli and dried coriander and stir until the garlic is golden.
instructions.12: Add the tasha to the tagine and serve.

fah-156.title: Mullet Fesikh (Fermented Fish)
fah-156.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-156.culturalNotes: Use coarse salt for the best result. Keep the tools clean to avoid contamination. Turn the container after a week for an even cure.

instructions.1: Buy the mullet — each at least half a kilo — with pink gills, firm flesh and scales on.
instructions.2: Clean the fish well: reach inside and wash the gills to remove dirt and residue.
instructions.3: Spread the fish in a colander and refrigerate overnight to drain.
instructions.4: After 24 hours, press the fish to release the liquids and squeeze it with a clean towel.
instructions.5: Make the curing mix from the coarse salt, chilli and turmeric and stir together.
instructions.6: Salt the fish inside and out, putting a tablespoon of the mix into each side of the gills and in the head.
instructions.7: Prepare a large container with a layer of salt, lay the fish in, then another layer of salt, and so on until all the fish is packed.
instructions.8: Cover the fish completely with salt, seal the container well and press the air out.
instructions.9: Wrap the container in cling film to keep air out, and store it in a dark place away from sun and air.
instructions.10: After a week, turn the container over and leave for another week.
instructions.11: After 14 days, the fesikh is ready.

fah-157.title: Preparing & Serving Mullet Fesikh
fah-157.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-157.culturalNotes: Remove the excess salt from the fesikh before serving. It keeps in the fridge for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Open the container of fesikh after 10 days of curing.
instructions.2: Wipe the excess salt off the surface of the fesikh with a towel.
instructions.3: Cut the fesikh into suitable pieces with scissors.
instructions.4: Open the spine and remove the unwanted parts.
instructions.5: Serve the fesikh with lemon, red pepper, green pepper and chopped spring onions.
instructions.6: Drizzle a little oil over the fesikh before serving.

fah-785.title: Three Healthy & Delicious Drinks
fah-785.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-785.culturalNotes: Chocolate sauce can replace the caramel in the Oreo milkshake. Adjust the honey in the spinach-strawberry drink to taste. A personal blender lets you serve the juice anywhere.

instructions.1: Make the Oreo milkshake:
instructions.2: Add ice to the jug.
instructions.3: Add a cup of vanilla ice cream.
instructions.4: Add a cup of milk.
instructions.5: Add 2 packets of chocolate biscuits.
instructions.6: Blend for 30 seconds.
instructions.7: Pour the drink into glasses.
instructions.8: Add caramel sauce to taste.
instructions.9: Make the spinach & strawberry drink:
instructions.10: Add a cup of spinach leaves.
instructions.12: Add a large piece of beetroot or 2 small ones.
instructions.13: Add a cup of orange juice.

fah-786.title: Four Easy Winter Drinks
fah-786.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-786.culturalNotes: Keep the sahlab and hot-chocolate powders in sealed, clean, dry jars. Sprinkle nuts on the sahlab for crunch.

instructions.1: Make the hot cider: mix the apple juice, cinnamon, star anise and orange slices in a pot. Simmer over the heat until the flavours blend.
instructions.2: Make the sahlab powder: mix the rice flour, icing sugar, milk powder, desiccated coconut, cornflour, toasted sesame, raisins and vanilla powder in a large bowl. Store in a sealed jar.
instructions.3: Make the sahlab: mix a cup of milk with a tablespoon of sahlab powder while cold. Bring to the boil while stirring. Pour into cups and serve.
instructions.4: Make the hot-chocolate powder: mix the icing sugar, cocoa, milk powder, cornflour and chocolate chips in a bowl. Store in a sealed jar.
instructions.5: Make the hot chocolate: mix a cup of milk with a tablespoon of the powder while cold. Bring to the boil while stirring. Pour into cups and serve with marshmallows.
instructions.6: Make the custard: mix a cup of milk with a tablespoon of custard powder, a teaspoon of sugar and two cardamom pods. Bring to the boil while stirring until thick. Pour into cups and garnish with coconut.

fah-787.title: Iced Coffee
fah-787.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-787.culturalNotes: Add a little caramel sauce for a sweeter, stronger taste.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix half a cup of instant coffee with a quarter cup of sugar and a tablespoon of vanilla ice cream powder.
instructions.2: Add two tablespoons of ice water and beat with an electric whisk until thick and foamy.
instructions.3: Add ice to two glasses, then pour the foamed coffee over the ice.
instructions.4: Stir well and serve the iced coffee cold.

fah-788.title: Spanish Latte
fah-788.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-788.culturalNotes: Add a little caramel sugar for a sweeter taste and richer flavour.

instructions.1: Dissolve the instant coffee in hot water.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk to the cup.
instructions.3: Add ice as desired.
instructions.4: Pour in the dissolved coffee.
instructions.5: Top up the cup with cold milk.
instructions.6: Stir everything together well.
instructions.7: Serve cold and enjoy.

fah-789.title: Espresso & Flat White
fah-789.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-789.culturalNotes: Serve the espresso and flat white hot or chilled. Dust the top with a little cinnamon or ground cocoa to garnish.

instructions.1: Pull the espresso using a coffee machine.
instructions.2: Pour the coffee into the cup.
instructions.3: Steam the milk until foamy.
instructions.4: Pour the foamy milk over the coffee.
instructions.5: Add sugar to taste.

fah-790.title: Nubian Tea (Shay bil-Laban)
fah-790.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-790.culturalNotes: Adjust the sugar to taste. Serve with cucumber and olives if you like.

instructions.1: Add a cup of water and a cup of milk to a pot.
instructions.2: Add 2 tea bags and a teaspoon of sugar.
instructions.3: Leave the mixture over low heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix half a cup of flour with a quarter cup of water and a pinch each of salt and sugar.
instructions.5: Add the egg and a teaspoon of oil and mix until no lumps remain.
instructions.6: Heat a pan and add a small drop of oil, spreading it evenly.
instructions.7: Add a small amount of the batter and swirl it around the pan until spread thin.
instructions.8: Flip the crepe once it takes light colour.
instructions.9: Add the romy cheese and fold the sandwich, heating both sides until the cheese melts.
instructions.10: Serve the sandwich with the cup of milky tea.

fah-791.title: Fresh Pineapple, Apple & Orange Juice
fah-791.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-791.culturalNotes: Add water or sugar to adjust the taste. The juice keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Prepare the pineapple: remove the skin and eyes and cut it into large chunks.
instructions.2: Put the pineapple pieces in the juicer and juice at the right speed.
instructions.3: Prepare the apple: wash it and cut it into large chunks without peeling.
instructions.4: Put the apple pieces in the juicer and juice them.
instructions.5: Prepare the orange: wash it and cut it in half.
instructions.6: Put the orange halves in the juicer and juice them.
instructions.7: Strain the juice through the filter to remove fibres and seeds.
instructions.8: Pour the juice into glasses and serve cold.

fah-792.title: Carob Juice (Kharoub)
fah-792.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-792.culturalNotes: Taste the juice and add more sugar or water as needed. The boiled carob pieces also make a nice snack for children.

instructions.1: Wash the carob well.
instructions.2: Add a quarter cup of water to the sugar and place it over the heat, stirring gently until it turns dark golden.
instructions.3: Add water gradually to the caramel.
instructions.4: Add about two litres of water to the washed carob and bring to the boil.
instructions.5: Cover the pot, lower the heat and leave for half an hour.
instructions.6: Strain the mixture through a fine sieve.
instructions.7: Add two litres of cold water to the juice.
instructions.8: Leave the juice to cool.
instructions.9: Fill the juice into bags and store in the freezer.

fah-793.title: Ramadan Doum Juice
fah-793.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-793.culturalNotes: Sweeten with honey instead of sugar for a healthier version. The juice keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Add half a cup of ground doum to a bowl.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of sugar.
instructions.3: Add two cups of milk.
instructions.4: Add two cups of boiling water.
instructions.5: Add a cup of ice.
instructions.6: Add nuts to taste.
instructions.7: Blend everything until combined.
instructions.8: Strain the juice into glasses.
instructions.9: Serve cold.
